bottom_line_fact.text: The S&P 500 Software Index is in a bear market with RSI at 18 (most oversold since 1990), IGV over 20% below its 200-day moving average, and EV/sales at 8x near November 2022 levels.

bottom_line_inference.text: If the agentic-AI disruption fear is overblown, these oversold software valuations could represent an entry point, though the article does not quantify upside.

catalyst.window_text: RSI below 30 historically incentivizes inflows; resolution of whether Claude Code disrupts SaaS
